title: One Dead and 15 Potentially Missing at Grand Canyon After Flash Flood
summary: At least 62 people were evacuated on Saturday after flooding destroyed footbridges and damaged a campground and cabins near Bright Angel Creek in Arizona, the National Park Service said.
